meta.description: Index of sweep outputs (hebb/sweeps/*.py; regenerate with hebb/sweeps/run_all.sh). Findings: docs/findings.md.

files.description: Planted-family allocation experiment (network N=150, 8 paired seeds): vary one block's variance or size; fraction of neurons in that block, missing modes, fitted beta; plus descriptive size-vs-energy scatter on powerlaw_pos12 and ring16.
Which ingredient changes the allocation exponent (gamma=0 limit): init log-weight spread, nonlinear weight-only regularizers, shared minibatch noise over time.
Allocation in the gamma=0, N->inf limit on Sigma=diag(v): fraction per input vs theta and init distribution; exponent beta in n ∝ v^beta.
Within-cluster diversity (L1 spread, 1 - voltage correlation, participation ratio) vs wmin, gamma, minibatch size, N, and (labelled comparison) sparse mask p.
Convergence time vs theta; mean-field vs minibatch (batch 8-512) on block12; init grid ii_scale x ib_scale.
Slow theta sweeps up and down with state carried over (block12, hier8; gamma 1 and 0): K, dead fraction, mean energy along the loop.

theta loop as in hysteresis.json but with private multiplicative weight jitter w <- w exp(sigma xi) every step (breaks the permutation symmetry that makes merged clusters unsplittable). 1500 steps (dt=0.05) per theta value, no convergence test.
Q1: exact stable parts (thresholded Perron vectors of Sigma - theta 11^T) per covariance and theta, vs. clusters the network populates (gamma 0/1, wmin 1e-5/1e-3, 4 seeds); eigenvector comparisons.

Phase diagrams: number of populated clusters K over theta x gamma, theta x wmin, theta x ii_scale, and N=60/240 (block12, hier8; seeds 0-2), with kappa0 for the predicted collective boundary theta = gamma*kappa0.
Weight-space readout of Sigma across theta (4 covariances, 2 seeds) in the three SPEC §7.3 settings, by edge family, with baselines; plus readout along training.
Verified explorer presets (chapters 1, 2, 4): exact parameters and per-seed outcomes.
